team-name.title: Team
team-name.body: A board your team shares, three seats. Notes move from an idea, to a running backtest, to a data-validated finding. Everyone seated sees the same notes and files, never each other's keys or accounts.

no-board-head.title: Open your board
no-board-head.body: Name the board and open it, then offer up to two more seats from the seats panel. Team boards come with Business, or with a seat a Business owner gives you.

data-head.title: Shared files
data-head.body: Files your team shares: CSV, TSV, text, Markdown or JSON, up to 5 MB each. Everyone seated can download them, stored exactly as uploaded.

seats-head.title: Seats
seats-head.body: Offer a seat to an existing QuantGPT account by its email; it joins once that account accepts. Three seats in all, yours included. Seated members share this board's notes and files, nothing else.
